name: Algebraic Identity Disguise
description: Replaced the explicit extremal target (-4m) and the uniform polynomial with a non-extremal, assignment-dependent global target ("total system risk"). The per-edge polynomial now includes a node-based term ($f_u^2 + f_v^2$) which globally sums to exactly the total system risk, leaving a hidden positive-definite polynomial that evaluates to 0 if and only if $f_u \neq f_v$. This defeats models that rely on surface pattern matching of the constant minimum target to deduce the 3-coloring constraint, forcing them to either perform the algebraic simplification or write an unpruned brute-force search that will TLE.
